candidates.snippet: 1947: Ordained as Baptist minister - King was ordained as a Baptist minister, marking an early step in his public life and ministry. 1951: Graduated from Crozer Theological Seminary - King completed his theological studies, earning a Bachelor of Divinity degree from Crozer. 1955: Montgomery Bus Boycott begins - King helped lead the Montgomery Bus Boycott, a major protest against racial segregation on public transport. 1963: March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom - King delivered his iconic 'I Have a Dream' speech during this massive demonstration for civil rights.
